$comment: Generated from assistant-api.openapi.json by scripts/generate_mcp_tools.py. MCP tool definitions; _http shows the mapping to the REST API.

tools.name: validateRequisitionRequest
tools.title: Check a draft request without creating anything
tools.description: Check a draft request without creating anything. Returns every problem with its field, code and a suggestion, plus the estimated total at catalogue prices. When valid, also returns confirmationSummary to show the user and confirmationToken to send on create once they agree. Call this before createRequisitionRequest.

costCenter.description: Cost center to charge, from GET /v1/reference/cost-centers.

plant.description: Receiving plant, from GET /v1/reference/plants. Must belong to the cost center's company.

neededBy.description: Date the goods or services are needed (yyyy-MM-dd), between tomorrow and one year ahead.

justification.description: Business reason in the user's words, 10-500 characters.

materialCode.description: Material or service code from GET /v1/reference/materials.

quantity.description: Quantity in the material's unit of measure, greater than 0 and at most 1000. Whole numbers for EA and BOX.

lines.description: 1-20 lines. Prices are taken from the catalogue; do not send prices.

assistantSessionRef.description: Optional reference to the assistant conversation, stored for audit.

tools.name: createRequisitionRequest
tools.title: Raise a purchase requisition for approval
tools.description: Raise a purchase requisition for approval. Creates the request as PendingApproval for the signed-in user; nothing is ordered until a person approves it. Requires an Idempotency-Key header and the X-User-Confirmation header (the confirmationToken from validate, sent only after the user agreed). Returns the request with its status.

costCenter.description: Cost center to charge, from GET /v1/reference/cost-centers.

plant.description: Receiving plant, from GET /v1/reference/plants. Must belong to the cost center's company.

neededBy.description: Date the goods or services are needed (yyyy-MM-dd), between tomorrow and one year ahead.

justification.description: Business reason in the user's words, 10-500 characters.

materialCode.description: Material or service code from GET /v1/reference/materials.

quantity.description: Quantity in the material's unit of measure, greater than 0 and at most 1000. Whole numbers for EA and BOX.

lines.description: 1-20 lines. Prices are taken from the catalogue; do not send prices.

assistantSessionRef.description: Optional reference to the assistant conversation, stored for audit.

idempotencyKey.description: Sent as the Idempotency-Key header. A new UUID per user intent; reuse only to retry the same request.

userConfirmation.description: Sent as the X-User-Confirmation header: the confirmationToken from validateRequisitionRequest, only after the user agreed to its confirmationSummary.

tools.name: listRequisitionRequests
tools.title: List the user's requests, least recently changed first
tools.description: List the user's requests, least recently changed first. Only the signed-in user's requests are returned. Page with cursor; limit is 1-50 (default 20).

tools.name: getRequisitionRequest
tools.title: Get the status of one of the user's requests
tools.description: Get the status of one of the user's requests. Returns status, a plain-language statusReason, nextExpectedStep, the SAP reference once transferred and a timeline. The ETag header is needed to withdraw. Users see their own requests; a delegated procurement role (requisitions:read:all) sees any.

tools.name: withdrawRequisitionRequest
tools.title: Withdraw one of the user's requests that is still awaiting approval
tools.description: Withdraw one of the user's requests that is still awaiting approval. Requires the user's explicit confirmation and If-Match with the ETag from the latest read. Requests already approved cannot be withdrawn.

ifMatch.description: ETag from the latest read; sent as If-Match.

tools.name: searchMaterials
tools.title: Search the material and service catalogue
tools.description: Search the material and service catalogue. Matches all words against code and description. Use the returned code in request lines; prices shown are what will be charged.

tools.name: listCostCenters
tools.title: List cost centers with their company and currency
tools.description: List cost centers with their company and currency.

tools.name: listPlants
tools.title: List receiving plants, optionally for one company
tools.description: List receiving plants, optionally for one company.
